description: This file contains the implementation of the DefaultStreamIdMapper class, which implements the IStreamIdMapper interface. It provides methods to map stream IDs to grain keys, supporting GUID and integer key types, with options to include namespace information.

classes.name: DefaultStreamIdMapper
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IStreamIdMapper that maps stream IDs to grain keys based on configuration and stream ID properties.

methods.name: GetGrainKeyId
methods.description: Determines the grain key ID for a given stream ID based on grain bindings and key type (GUID or Int64).

methods.name: GetGuidKey
methods.description: Generates a GUID-based grain key, optionally including namespace information.

methods.name: GetIntegerKey
methods.description: Generates an integer-based grain key, optionally including namespace information.
